summary: RadNet filed an 8-K reporting a prospectus supplement to its Form S-3 shelf, registering 34,069 shares for resale by See-Mode Sellers. These shares are the stock component of milestone payments under a June 2025 Share Purchase Agreement with DH AI International Holdings. No special situation is present; this is a routine resale registration. The filing includes a legal opinion on share validity. No deal terms, premium, or transaction structure are disclosed. Watch for potential sell-down by selling stockholders, but no risk-arb angle applies.
